verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a conversational AI coding agent for C and C++. Users drive it by messaging it in a TUI conversation, by sending messages into a running session via `byteask queue --message`, or by handing `byteask exec` a task to run to completion. The agent then reads the codebase, edits files, compiles and runs tests. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language prompt syntax and examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of command-following quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: ByteAsk opens a full-screen TUI, reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests, and presents a diff for your review before making permanent changes
sends a message into a running session from another terminal
it runs one task to completion and exits
